description: Pair designed to exercise `[` (Backward) auto-align convergence. LEFT has a 2-s synthetic `testsrc2` intro prepended to source[124..]; RIGHT is source[124..] with no intro. At both raw=0 their contents don't overlap (LEFT shows testsrc, RIGHT shows source[124]). After a brief forward playback both sides land on real content, with LEFT's content trailing RIGHT's by 2 seconds — the aligned shift is negative, making `[` the natural convergence key.

check_points.rationale: First aligned frame: left raw=+2002000us, right raw=0. Expected effective_time_shift = right - left = -2002000us.
